source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8 with Fig. 9.18 (PDF 206-207).

blocks.text: Charged particle ka raasta us jagah ki electric field tay karti hai. Agar field uniform ho aur particle field ke saath saath chal raha ho to raasta aam taur par seedha hota hai. Lekin agar charged particle ulte charges wali parallel (mutawazi) plates ke darmiyan uniform field mein field ke seedha (perpendicular) kisi velocity se dakhil ho (Fig. 9.18), to woh seedha nahi jayega. Us ka raasta parabola (mura hua raasta) hoga, bilkul us projectile ki tarah jo gravity mein horizontal phenka jaye. Particle ki velocity ka horizontal hissa (component) nahi badalta, jabke vertical hissa electric force ki wajah se barhta jata hai.

blocks.alt: Do hisse, oopar + aur neeche - plate, magenta lines neeche. (a) Positive (musbat) particle (zarra) baen se dakhil, dotted rasta neeche (-) plate tak murta hai. (b) Negative (manfi) particle baen se dakhil, dotted rasta oopar (+) plate tak murta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.18 (kitab ki Figure 9.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Horizontal velocity nahi badalti, magar field ki force vertical speed (raftar) barhati hai; is liye raasta projectile jaisa parabola hai. (a) Positive particle neeche − plate ki taraf murta hai; (b) negative particle oopar + plate ki taraf.

Fig. 9.18 dikhati hai ke positive charged particle negative plate ki taraf kheencha jata hai aur usi taraf mur jata (deflect hota) hai. Doosri taraf negative charged particle positive plate ki taraf kheencha jata hai aur usi taraf murta hai.

blocks.caption: Charged particle aur projectile ka muqabla

blocks.prompt: Ek positive aur ek negative particle horizontal plates (oopar wali plate positive) ke darmiyan field mein horizontal chalte hue dakhil hote hain. Dono ke raaste describe karein.
blocks.explanation: Dono apni horizontal velocity constant (wohi) rakhte hain jabke electric force un ki vertical velocity barabar rate se badalti hai, is liye dono parabola par chalte hain. Positive particle neeche negative plate ki taraf murta hai; negative particle oopar positive plate ki taraf. (Jo particle field lines ke saath chale woh seedhi lakeer mein jata hai, sirf tez ya dheema hota hai.)

items: Uniform field ke saath chalna: seedha raasta.
Field ke seedha dakhil hona: horizontal projectile jaisa parabola; horizontal velocity constant, vertical velocity barhti hai.
Positive charge − plate ki taraf, negative charge + plate ki taraf murta hai.
